channel.title: Muse Ember — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases: 9–15 November 2026
item.description: Fable 5.2 lowers token rates, Gemini 4 Hydrogen reaches the API, and DeepSeek and Perplexity change how common workflows are billed. Token-price pairs give input and output per million tokens. Dollar prices are USD.

item.title: Muse Ember triples direct rates above 200,000 input tokens
item.description: Meta applies the long-context rates to the whole request. Cached input and restored conversation history count toward the threshold.
